aluminum_melting_2.name: Melting of Aluminum - Level 2
aluminum_melting_2.description: Simulate the melting of Aluminum by heating under NPT conditions using the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential. The simulation should replicate the system by 3 times in each direction. Monitor the Al–Al bond length using the partial radial distribution function (RDF) throughout the heating. Identify the phase change where the first RDF peak shows a significant change, defined as more than 10% increase from the initial value. Report the final average Al–Al bond length in the molten state in Å.
